notes: Modular/field-swappable I/O platform (LivePremier series, ref. AQL-RS4). Specs reflect the standard factory configuration: 12x HDMI 2.0 + 8x DisplayPort 1.2 + 4x 12G-SDI inputs (24 total), 16x HDMI 2.0 outputs, 2x dedicated HDMI 2.0 multiviewer outputs. Input/output cards are field-swappable for alternate arrangements (e.g. 4x DP 1.4, 8x HDMI 1.4, 8x 3G-SDI, NDI+12G-SDI, SFP+, Optical, SDVoE, ST 2110) — not modeled here since those are optional alternates, not the base config. Genlock BNC has a physical loop-out (2 BNC connectors: reference in + loop out) for Framelock/Blackburst/Tri-level sync — grade omitted since this is analog sync reference, not SDI video. Dual-redundancy Ethernet ports serve Dante/AES67 audio networking (64x64 @48kHz); a separate Ethernet connection is used for Web RCS/REST API/TCP control — datasheet doesn't give a distinct rear-panel count for control vs. Dante RJ45s beyond the two Dante ports, so only the two Dante-labeled RJ45s are included here (control likely shares one of these or a dedicated mgmt port not itemized in the datasheet). Tally/GPI-O is present but the datasheet gives no connector type/pin-count (commonly a euroblock or DB-style connector on this product line) — omitted rather than guessed. Power: "Swappable redundant power supplies (2+1)" at 100-240VAC 12-7A, 3x power cords supplied — modeled as 3x IEC C14 inlets (standard AV/broadcast rack convention for this class of device); exact inlet type (C13/C14 vs C19) not explicitly shown in the datasheet text, so treat as inferred. No USB or RS232 ports are listed in the datasheet. Rack size 5RU confirmed.

ports.name: Input 21-24 (12G-SDI)
ports.note: 4x 12G-SDI inputs, up to 4K60p 10-bit 4:2:2; backward compatible with 3G-SDI/6G-SDI

ports.name: Multiviewer Out 1-2 (HDMI)
ports.note: 2x dedicated HDMI 2.0 multiviewer outputs, configurable as 2x 4K30p or 1x4K60p+1 duplicated or 2x 2560x1440@60p
